bottom_line: Re-pulled live and re-scored under the frozen pipeline: the discovery headline does NOT reproduce (post-DDR rho -0.209 vs published -0.711); the only positive external cohort remains BriTROC-1 (CN sig7, 3 resistant, EPV=3); the independent expression cohort GSE160626 is OPPOSITE direction (PI3K p=0.043); paired cohorts lack resistance labels and cannot test prediction. The resistance-PREDICTION claim does not replicate in openly obtainable data. A paired serial cohort WITH platinum-response outcomes (the HERCULES/MSK-SPECTRUM design) is required to test it, and is behind controlled access.
